summary: 9/9 edge cases pass format validation. All choices match rule methods lists. Act distribution: DEG=2 (n2, nofilter), PanCancer=4 (claim, epv, consistency, purity), scRNA=3 (nodoublet, default, singleanno). 3 design-vs-actual discrepancies noted (rule definitions are canonical). E2 moved from DEG→PanCancer per user review (purity_confounding ∉ DEG domain). E9 actual_level corrected 3→2 after D5 fix (2026-08-13).

cases.mechanism: override_n2: n_replicates <= 2 forces all methods to Level 0
purity_ignored is explicitly listed at Level 0 in I4.2-IMMU-001 (PanCancer immune rules, NOT DEG rules)
cases.fix_note: Moved from Act 1 (DEG) to Act 2 (PanCancer) — purity_confounding is an immune-expression correlation concept, not a DEG concept. DEG Act has only 5 decision_types: filtering/normalization/deg_method/correction/threshold.

cases.mechanism: no_filtering = Level 1 (retains all genes, increases multiple testing burden)
no_correction = Level 0 (no FDR control on ~20K parallel tests)
raw p-value without fold-change threshold = Level 1
direction contradiction not discussed = Level 1 (broken conclusion chain)

cases.note: Design doc says Level 1, but rule D1.1-DOUB-001 defines no_doublet_detection at Level 0. Rule is canonical.
Design doc says Level 2, but rule C1.2-CLUS-002 defines default_0_8 at Level 1. Rule is canonical.

cases.mechanism: SingleR = Level 2 (reference-based, single-method annotation without cross-validation)
cases.note: D5 FIX（2026-08-13）后：原记录 actual=3 是无条件条件提升 bug 的产物；修复后不再虚增，SingleR 稳定为 Level 2。设计文档 Level 2 与引擎一致。

design_vs_actual_discrepancies.resolution: Rule definition is canonical. no_doublet_detection is correctly scored as Level 0. Design doc expectation was approximate.
Rule definition is canonical. default_0_8 is correctly scored as Level 1. Using default resolution without justification is a genuine risk.
D5 FIX（2026-08-13）后与设计一致。原 engine_output=3 是 D5 无条件条件提升 bug 的产物（SingleR L2→L3 虚增），修复后不再提升，SingleR 稳定为 Level 2。

note: 2026-08-13 A4 同步：E9 actual_level 3→2（D5 修复后重跑引擎实测）；validation_dataset.jsonl 与 full_audit_results.json 已用修复后引擎重生成，口径统一（trajectory_score = 最低维度分）。
